data.title: Over 70 people rally in support of Thunder Bay library workers: ‘If you have to strike, we’ll be with you on the picket line’
data.description: In Thunder Bay, Ontario, more than 70 individuals gathered for a solidarity rally on Thursday evening, October 8, to show support for Thunder Bay Public Library (TBPL) workers. The rally occurred outside the Waverley Branch as the library faces a potential strike with a deadline approaching in a week. Coinciding with the library's Board of Directors' monthly meeting, the rally aimed to protest against the board's insistence on concessions during negotiations. Margaret Demillo, the President of CU, emphasized the workers' desire for a fair agreement that allows them to continue their passion for their work.

data.title: UiPath Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Agentic Software Quality Assurance Platforms
data.description: UiPath has recently been acknowledged as a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Agentic Software Quality Assurance Platforms. This recognition highlights UiPath's position as a top player in the industry, reflecting their commitment to excellence in software quality assurance. The Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ is a prestigious evaluation that ranks companies based on their completeness of vision and ability to execute. By being positioned as a Leader, UiPath has distinguished itself from competitors and solidified its reputation in the field. This recognition is a testament to UiPath's dedication to providing high-quality software solutions.

data.title: NTT DATA Expands Global Cyber Defense Footprint With New Operations Center in North Texas
data.description: In Plano, Texas, NTT DATA held a ribbon-cutting event on October 9, 2026, to inaugurate its new Cyber Defense Center. This facility marks the expansion of NTT DATA’s worldwide cyber defense network, integrating AI-driven technologies, international threat insights, and human proficiency to aid organizations in identifying, examining, and addressing cyber threats. The launch exemplifies NTT DATA's ongoing commitment to North Texas and its stronghold in the region.
